Validation -- pySim SAIP fill-pattern defects
=============================================

pySim: site-packages build, version 1.0. The in-tree upstream checkout
carries the same two defects (its file_content_from_tuples differs only in
an unrelated raise/return on the unknown-key path).

5. Bug 3 -- a record template's default value once per file, not per record
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

The repro gained ``case_template_default_per_record`` (EF ICI shape, two
records of 38 B, default 'FF...FF0000000001FFFF'), so the case count is now
10. Section 1 above predates it (2/9 there is 2/10 now, the new case failing).

BEFORE -- stock pySim (in-tree upstream checkout):

[FAIL] template default per record
         11FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF0000000001FFFF

2/10 cases pass

The default's tail lands once, at the end of the 76-byte file; record 1 ends
erased where the card holds 0000000001FFFF.

AFTER -- stock pySim + the YggdraSIM-side compensations
(install_record_aware_template_default beside the two earlier installers):

[PASS] template default per record
         11FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF0000000001FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF0000000001FFFF

10/10 cases pass

Shipped reference profile (Tools/ProfilePackage/profile/reference_test_profile.txt):
the OPT-USIM EF ICI and EF OCI bodies now start from the per-record default,
and the padded-content trimmer (saip.trim_padded_content) drops the 620 B of
each that the template already provides; 8884 B -> 7088 B of DER over the
whole package with every file image replaying unchanged.
